parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides support and defines the overall shape and compartments of the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet door and internal shelves, maintaining the rigidity and stability of the entire structure.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable barrier to open or close the cabinet, protecting the contents from dust and providing an aesthetic finish.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close, allowing access to the cabinet interior.
